634A.summary_en: LAYERED Inc. provides medical digital transformation (DX) services. The company offers products, such as Kakarite, a patient management and communication support system; and Medical Window, medical information media; and services, including website production and operation support for medical institutions. The company serves clinics, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and local governments. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

627A.summary_en: akippa Inc. owns and operates an online marketplace for vacant car parking space reservation and rental. Its platform offers a smart parking experience to park a car anywhere in the city. akippa Inc. was formerly known as Galaxy Agency Inc. and changed its name to akippa Inc. in February 2015. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

623A.summary_en: Vertex Co., Ltd. provides real estate services in Japan. It offers real estate consulting, real estate planning and development, real estate sales, rental brokerage, and property management services. The company also involves in business of real estate fund and non-life insurance agency, as well as business related to the solicitation of life insurance. Vertex Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

622A.summary_en: Techno Craft Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells IT solutions in Japan. The company offers products, such as GPS-based cart navigation and fleet management systems for golf courses under the Marshal-Ai brand, a cloud-based business support system for childcare facilities named Commu-Navi, and health monitoring solutions using GPS technology; and services, including application development, ASP services, and support for its various control terminals. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Niigata-shi, Japan.

625A.summary_en: Skyfall Inc. provides digital marketing and advertising technology (AdTech) services in Japan. The company offers services, such as marketing support and media platform development, to connect users with products and services and support the growth of partner companies. It products includes SKYFLAG, a reward marketing platform designed to enhance the user experience and drive service engagement; Poker Chase, a battle royale-style Texas Hold'em poker game; POCKET PLAY, a rewards app that lets users earn points simply by playing their favorite games; and SKYORDER, a self-ordering system for restaurants that goes beyond streamlining operations. The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

621A.summary_en: Audiostock Inc. owns and operates an online community platform where music creators can present and share their music audios. The company offers a platform for music creators to register their music and sell usage rights, receiving royalties based on sales. It also provides a marketplace for music creators to sell their work and for users to purchase licenses. Audiostock Inc. was formerly known as CreoFuga, Inc. and changed its name to Audiostock Inc. in July 2020. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Okayama, Japan.

619A.summary_en: Oliver Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells interior design products in Japan. The company offers task chairs, desks, sofas, lobby chairs, tables, outdoor furniture, cabinets, executive and reception furniture, kids' furniture, private booths, and other equipment. It caters to hotels, offices, restaurants, and commercial and medical facilities. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in Okazaki, Japan.

618A.summary_en: KOMPEITO Inc. engages in the operation of an employee-benefit food service in Japan. The company offers OFFICE DE YASAI, a refrigerator that delivers fresh vegetables; OFFICE DE MEDIA, a digital signage displays product information for OFFICE DE YASAI, as well as TV commercials, weather forecasts, and other content; and SALAD STAND, a salad vending machine that helps to reduce food waste. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

607A.summary_en: every,Inc. owns and operates various platforms that provide video media and advertising solutions in Japan. The company's platforms include Delish Kitchen, which delivers recipe videos; retail HUB, including Store DX, which involves installing digital signage in retail stores; Tomonite, which helps with child-rearing; and MOMENTH, which offers services that address companies' marketing challenges. It also offers tie-up advertising, display ads, store vision ads, user matching ads, performance-based advertising, and ad network advertising. every,Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

604A.summary_en: beABLE CO.,LTD. engages in construction business and renewable energy business in Japan. The construction business focuses on maintenance and inspection work for nuclear power plants; The renewable energy business focuses on development, construction, and maintenance of renewable energy. It also engages in day care service for the elderly, gym services, and restaurant services. In addition, the company engages in electricity retail business. beABLE CO.,LTD. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Futaba, Japan.

603A.summary_en: i GRID SOLUTIONS Inc. develops and operates platforms that enable the integrated utilization of distributed energy resources in Japan. It operates through GX Solution Business and Energy Trading Business segments. The company develops and operates on-site solar power plants, as well as provides related support and consulting services. It also provides various services related to promoting green transformation, including battery storage and EV-related services; and offers energy trading services for the use and circulation of renewable energy resources. The company was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

593A.summary_en: Tier IV, Inc. develops open-source software solutions for autonomous driving. It develops Autoware, which is a software for urban driverless cars and supports 3D localization, object detection, path planning and following, and lane detection. In addition, the company offers self-driving development kit; autoware loggers; and autoware remove drive kit. It also offers sensor fusion technologies and products, including laser scanners and cameras. It also offers mobility services, development services, and solution services, covering deployment of autonomous driving systems, system integration, testing, operation support, and maintenance. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

598A.summary_en: ChatPlus Co.,Ltd. develops and provides SaaS-based subscription-based chatbot systems in Japan. The chatbot system is a service that supports companies in improving operational efficiency and productivity by automating and reducing the manpower required to handle inquiries from both inside and outside the company. It offers ChatPlus, a chatbot that supports the automation of corporate inquiry handling and communication, employing a format; AI Agent Plus, a chatbot that integrates generation AI such as ChatCPT with Chat Plus to generate optimal responses on the spot in addition to registered answers, enabling it to handle complex inquiries and diverse expressions from visitors and provide natural conversational responses; and FAQPlus, a system for creating, organizing, and managing articles of frequently asked questions and answers, so that users can easily find the answers they need. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

590A.summary_en: giftee Group, Inc. engages in the creation, distribution, and sale of e-gifts. It sells its e-gifts online via smartphones and other devices. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

589A.summary_en: NEIS Co.,Ltd. operates as a franchisor and operator of children's gymnastics clubs. The company provides child development support and after-school day services and assists children with developmental disabilities. It also manufactures classroom equipment, apparel, and other goods. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. NEIS Co.,Ltd. is a subsidiary of Minami no Shima Co., Ltd.

584A.summary_en: LiNKX, Inc. operates as a financial technology company in Japan. The company specializes in modernization and reconstruction through cloud-based and AI-based technologies. It offers design and implementation methods to support the development of systems such as accounting systems, API gateways, and data infrastructure for the financial sector, including banks. Its products include LabHub, a platform which supports productivity improvement for researchers, including pharmaceutical companies; and shikAI, a navigation system for the visually impaired, as a social contribution project. The company was formerly known as Links Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LiNKX, Inc. in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

581A.summary_en: GO Inc. designs and develops a taxi-hailing application that enables users to arrange and schedule a cab ride in Japan. The company's application offers real-time location information sharing, digitalization of operations for taxi companies, management service, and decarbonization services. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

575A.summary_en: MAEZAWA Holdings CO.,LTD., through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of water supply and sewage-related products. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

559A.summary_en: Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd. engages in the production, sale, and product development of sake, liqueurs, and assorted beverages in Japan and internationally. The company offers alcoholic beverages, including Japanese sake and fruit-infused sake liqueurs through the Aragoshi and Umenoyado no Umeshu brands. Umenoyado Brewery Co., Ltd. was founded in 1893 and is headquartered in Katsuragi, Japan.

556A.summary_en: INUNEKO-SEIKATSU Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells pet food products in Japan. The company offers prepared packaged food for cats and dogs. The company also provides in-house health checkups and blood test services, as well as veterinary clinic and grooming salon services. The company was formerly known as Honest Food Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

558A.summary_en: SQUEEZE Inc. designs and develops an artificial intelligence (AI)-based platform for hospitality and tourism industry. The company's platform offers accounting management, revenue management, property management, cloud reception, cleaning and housekeeping, and facility operations services. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Kitahiroshima, Japan.

554A.summary_en: Batonz Co., Ltd. plan, develops, and operates an M&A support platform to offer business succession matching services via the Internet in Japan. The company offers internet-based M&A matching, management consulting, website planning, production, operation, and management consulting websites using the internet. It provides services such as, M&A Platform, includes matching service, sourcing support services, and FA support services; and M&A SaaS, includes partner program, B MASS, and customer management system. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

550A.summary_en: Softtex Co.,Ltd. engages in the computer system design and software development business. It operates through two segments, Software Development Services and Medical IT Services. It offers disaster prevention equipment manufacturers, computer manufacturers, system integrators, and information systems. The company also offers internet-related system services; consultation and education on computer usage; development, sales, and support of software packages; and construction and support of medical systems. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Nagoya, Japan with additional offices in Tokyo, Sapporo, and Okinawa, Japan.

549A.summary_en: HITO-TO-HITO Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the event operation management, security and cleaning, staffing, and sales promotion businesses. It engages in the operation of sporting events; security and cleaning of office buildings and commercial facilities; and provision of staffing services for companies, as well as support for product and service sales. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

548A.summary_en: SystemEXE,Inc. engages in the system integration business. It provides business system development, scratch development, IT infrastructure construction, cloud integration, AI solutions, database services, data utilization, operations and maintenance, PMO support, system migration, DX (digital transformation) solutions, offshore development, groupware workflow, and IoT services, as well as data analysis infrastructure construction and report-based DX promotion solutions. The company serves real estate, manufacturing, non-life and life insurance, medical care, petroleum, chemical, and other industries. SystemEXE,Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

542A.summary_en: Vitabrid Japan Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells wellness products. The company's products include face brightening powder, shampoo, wrinkle serum, wrinkle cream, cleansing balm, and age-defying and firming mask. It sells its products through the internet. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. Vitabrid Japan Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Vector Inc.

547A.summary_en: Muninova Holdings Inc. engages in the consumer finance and credit guarantee business in Japan. It offers loans for individuals and businesses; credit cards, prepaid cards, individual credit purchase arrangements, and deferred payment options; credit guarantees; and pet insurance, as well as investing in a range of businesses. The company is also involved in leaseback, corporate restructuring, small amount short-term insurance business, venture capital, and SES business, rent guarantee, and crowdfunding businesses, as well as the provision of system development, maintenance, and operation services for its clients. Aiful Corporation was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

546A.summary_en: Miraini Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of electronic components, electronic devices, and electronic equipment. It is also involved in the manufacture and sale of FA equipment; development and design of embedded software and various systems; and related businesses. The company was founded in 1947 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

545A.summary_en: Toranvia Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the software development, computer operations management, system solution services, and related businesses. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

544A.summary_en: GMS Group Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of injection molding machines, molds, automated molding systems, and measuring instruments. It also offers die casting machines and related automated equipment. The company was founded in 1925 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

543A.summary_en: ARCHION Corporation manufactures and sells commercial vehicles under the FUSO and HINO brands. It offers trucks and buses; light commercial and passenger vehicles, as well as various engines, service parts, etc. The company was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

523A.summary_en:
SEIWA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells highway signs; and fabricates inspection lanes and steel brackets. The company provides zinc plating services, structures for public works, overhead cranes, hydraulic parts, wire harnesses, industrial and ship cables, temperature-measuring cables, rubber molding machines, vacuum-type rubber vulcanization molding machines, system molding machines, press-fitting machines, generator and engine covers for ships, cationic electrodeposition coating services, gas injection equipment, nitrogen generators, bio-related equipment, and reflective liquid level gauges. It also offers 
transparent liquid level gauges, round glass liquid level gauges, water level gauges, magnetic liquid level gauges, welded liquid level gauges, sight glasses, transparent cases, packaging materials, V-packs, painting services for automotive parts, electroplating, electroless nickel plating, nickel-chromium plating, surface treatment services, chemical conversion coating treatment, lane dividers, safety equipment, processed cables, electrical and electronic components, printed circuit boards, control equipment, agricultural hotbed wire, lighting cables, and illumination products. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

520A.summary_en: J-Pharma Co., Ltd. is engaged in the research and development of pharmaceutical drugs in Japan. The company researches and develops drugs targeting solute carrier (SLC) transporters, with emphasis on the LAT1 amino acid transporter. It is developing several compounds for various medical indications, including nanvuranlat (JPH203), a novel small-molecule compound identified as a selective inhibitor of LAT1 and provide treatment for biliary tract cancer, as well as for colorectal cancer; JPH034 is characterized as high brain penetrance and development for disorders of the central nervous system, including non-relapsing secondary progressive multiple sclerosis and glioma; and JPT-0008 for solid tumor, autoimmune diseases, and rare diseases. It also conducting clinical trail for biliary tract cancer and JPH034. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Minato, Japan.

519A.summary_en: Basic Inc. develops SaaS platform and digital solutions for the B2B marketing field. The company's products include ferret One, a B2B marketing tool for creating websites and managing leads; formrun, a no-code form builder with simple customer management functions; bookrun, a scheduling tool for coordinating appointments; workrun, an AI-based workflow tool for automating basic tasks; and AIBOW, an AI agent system that supports routine operational work. Basic Inc. was founded in 2004 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

505A.summary_en: Geekly, Inc. operates as an information technology recruitment company in Japan. The company operates as a recruitment agency specializing in the information technology, web, and gaming industries. Geekly, Inc. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

504A.summary_en: Innovacell Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells cell therapy and regenerative medicine products. The company's products include ICEF15, a cell treatment for urgent fecal incontinence; ICEF16, a cell therapy for leaky fecal incontinence; and ICES13, a cell therapy for stress urinary incontinence. Innovacell Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

500A.summary_en: TO Books, Inc. engages in the content production business that publishes and sells comics and novels in Japan. The company offers picture books, anime, movies, stage plays, drama CDs, and audiobooks. It sells its products through the internet. The company was incorporated in 2014 and is based in Shibuya, Japan. TO Books, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of MTS Co., Ltd.

480A.summary_en: LiB Consulting co.,ltd provides management consulting services in Japan and internationally. The company offers services for IT; telecommunications; media; finance; industrial goods; trading companies; consumer goods; healthcare and life sciences; construction and real estate; mobility and energy; car dealer; housing and real estate; and venture and startups sectors. LiB Consulting co.,ltd was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

479A.summary_en: PRONI, Inc. owns and operates a business to business (B2B) ordering platform. The company's platform offers business matching service, navigation system, DX navigation system, DX ultimate navigator, IT ranking, and PRONI magazine. It also provides characteristics, achievements, and services of suppliers, subcontractors, and outsourcers, and information and price quotes. The company was formerly known as unilabo, Inc. and changed its name to PRONI, Inc. in August 2023. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

478A.summary_en: Hutzper Inc. provides artificial intelligence services for the manufacturing industry in Japan. It offers Mekikibite, an AI solution for visual inspection and quality control in manufacturing; Custom Hutzper AI for contract development services; Skill Puzzle, an AI solution for optimizing personnel allocation in the manufacturing industry; Laclag, a local LLM solution. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

483A.summary_en: Tera Technology, Inc. operates as an information technology consulting company that offers information system design, operation, and maintenance services in Japan. The company offers services for business in five areas including public, communications, information services, finance, and manufacturing and others. The company's services for the public include electronic application system for local governments, billing acceptance system for care service providers, government integrated portal system, electronic approval system, support for big data operations in public institutions, and grant application system. It offers various system development projects for the telecommunications carrier industry, such as network infrastructure and content distribution. The company caters to information system industry by providing services, such as TV shopping EC site development, e-commerce website development for individuals/corporations, magazine production support system, department store point service system, delivery status management system for courier services, membership site for healthcare professionals, customer management system for cosmetics manufacturers, infrastructure construction for cloud service providers, migrating existing systems to the cloud, and core systems for internet service providers. Additionally, it offers software development services for finance, insurance, and securities companies. It also engages in the development of software for various manufacturing companies including automotive equipment, industrial machinery, medical device, in-house development, and service deployment. The company was formerly known as Terra International Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tera Technology, Inc. in February 2016. Tera Technology, Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Toshima, Japan.

477A.summary_en: Startline CO.,LTD. provides comprehensive employment support services for people with disabilities. The company offers supported satellite offices for employing people with disabilities, including INCLU and INCLU ONE; employment support services for people with disabilities, including IBUKI, BYSN, RESQWO, and home-based employment support service; TASKI; job site for people with disabilities; personnel placement service exclusively for people with disabilities; various training and seminars on employment for people with disabilities; support for establishing special subsidiary companies; and dispatch of professional personnel for supporting the professional lives of people with disabilities. It also provides employment transition support/employment retention support services; real job training station; job counseling and consultation for job seekers with disabilities; education and training for people with disabilities; operation of training programs commissioned by public institutions; and acceptance of interns and practical training. The company was founded in 2009 and is based in Mitaka, Japan.

485A.summary_en: PowerX,Inc. manufactures and sells energy storage systems. It provides stationary energy storage systems, including PowerX Mega Power; PowerX cube for grid-mounted batteries, renewable energy-integrated batteries, and industrial and commercial batteries; and PowerX Hypercharger for commercial EV charging/public charging infrastructure applications, as well as battery tankers for maritime business. The company also offers electricity supply and aggregation services, as well as electric vehicle charging services. In additionit provides its services through PowerX app. PowerX,Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Tamano, Japan.

476A.summary_en: Tsuji Hongo IT Consulting Co.,Ltd. develops a digital transformation platform designed to provide specialized know-how for better decision-making in the areas of corporate operations, inheritance tax, and accounting practices. It provides consulting services including business visualization, business improvement, early monthly settlement, strengthening of internal controls, management accounting support, and standardization of accounting operations; and technology which provides support in proposing and implementing the optimal system and promote business transformation through the power of technology, including software and hardware sales agency. It also provides operation outsourcing services, from system setup services to back-office operations such as bookkeeping, payroll, and other accounting support such as invoice issuance. The company also offers development and operation of web services for accounting firms and SaaS based accounting/HR operation and dispatching specialist personnel. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Shibuya, Japan. Tsuji Hongo IT Consulting Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Hongo Holdings Co., Ltd.

475A.summary_en: GIMIC Co., Ltd. develops and operates a medical service software. It offers Doctor's File, a medical information website; Hospitals File, a hospital-based medical information site, as well as medical information magazine and veterinary hospital information website; Doctor's File Medipathy, an information sharing app for medical institutions; Doctor's File Apo Registus, a reservation management system that supports the management of medical institutions; Doctors File Appo, a web reservation management system for clinics; and Doctor's File LINK, a website creation service for clinics. The company also provides Doctor's File Clinico, a clinic-specific personnel evaluation/ talent management system; Doctor's File Jobs, a medical job search site; Doctors File Agent, a job placement service for healthcare professionals; Doctor's File Aporegitas, a LINE-integrated appointment management system; Hospitals that Value Medical Collaboration, an information platform booklet; and MedicallianceDAY, an in-person regional medical collaboration event, and Human Resources Outpatient Clinic, a personnel consultation service for clinics. In addition, it offers D-Search, a medical collaboration platform; Clinic Future Lab, Clinic management information media. GIMIC Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.
